# color-management-decision (reference summary)

## Purpose
Pin Display Device, View Transform, Look, and Sequencer per consumer pipeline (web sRGB, VFX ACES linear, game engine, print, GLB-Three.js) before render.

Avoid the most common Blender color mistake: rendering with the wrong color space and then "fixing" it in post. Pick the color management strategy upfront based on the consumer's color pipeline.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/color-management-decision/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/color-management-decision/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `render-and-output-decisions` / `view-transform-and-colorspace-selector`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- before render / lookdev pass
- when consumer color pipeline is known
- when a previous render had unexpected color shifts

## Trigger cues
- "what color space"
- "Filmic vs Standard"
- "ACEScg for our pipeline"
- "colors look weird"

## When not to use
- Post-render color grading or soft-proofing (handled by compositor / DCC after render). → delegate to `output-format-decision` (`references/skills/output-format-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to output-format-decision)
- Validating per-material texture color spaces such as sRGB vs Non-Color/Linear (material-quality-checker). → delegate to `material-quality-checker` (`references/skills/material-quality-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to material-quality-checker)
- Selecting file formats or bit depths (output-format-decision). → delegate to `output-format-decision` (`references/skills/output-format-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to output-format-decision)
- Choosing the render engine (cycles-vs-eevee-decision). → delegate to `cycles-vs-eevee-decision` (`references/skills/cycles-vs-eevee-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to cycles-vs-eevee-decision)
- Monitor hardware calibration (out of scope). → delegate to `material-quality-checker` (`references/skills/material-quality-checker.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to material-quality-checker)
- Raw modeling without lookdev (color management does not affect geometry accuracy). → delegate to `cycles-vs-eevee-decision` (`references/skills/cycles-vs-eevee-decision.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to cycles-vs-eevee-decision)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `target_delivery_pipeline` (`string`): Target display or compositing pipeline (web sRGB, product brand match, ACEScg VFX, HDR)
- `blender_version_posture` (`string`): Target Blender version family (3.6 LTS Filmic, 4.0+ AgX, 5.1+ AgX/ACES)

### Optional inputs
- `brand_hex_swatch_constraints` (`array`): Optional strict brand hex colors requiring Standard vs tone-mapped tradeoffs

### Primary outputs
- `pinned_view_transform_and_look`
- `display_and_working_colorspace_spec`
- `cross_engine_and_web_color_caveats`

## Quick-start procedure
1. Identify the consumer pipeline (`web sRGB` / `film/VFX ACES linear` / `game engine` / `print` / `GLB-Three.js`).
2. Pin the 4-line render color config: `Display Device`, `View Transform`, `Look`, and `Sequencer`.
3. Define per-output color transforms if multiple outputs exist.
4. Emit the 4-line config record, caveats, truth states (`Not Run` / `Not Produced`), and handoff.

## Handoff notes
- **[progression]** Output format selection → `output-format-decision` (`references/skills/output-format-decision.md`) — `when.all: [decision.formatLocked equals false]`
- **[progression]** Material texture color spaces → `material-quality-checker` (`references/skills/material-quality-checker.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "material"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[progression]** Render engine choice → `cycles-vs-eevee-decision` (`references/skills/cycles-vs-eevee-decision.md`) — `when.all: [decision.engineLocked equals false]`
- **[progression]** GLB Three.js delivery → `glb-web-handoff` (`references/skills/glb-web-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; handoff.consumerStack equals "web_glb"]`
- **[progression]** Render evidence verification → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skills/render-export-evidence.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "post_execution_audit"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Decision skill — does not run Blender. Pins config; operator applies in scene render properties.
- Validate per-material texture color spaces (`material-quality-checker`).
- Choose output file formats or bit depths (`output-format-decision`).
- Choose the render engine (`cycles-vs-eevee-decision`).
- Perform post-render color grading (belongs to compositor / DCC).
- Calibrate a physical monitor (out of scope).
- Run Blender or execute renders.
